parameters.query:
-- Orders placed in the last 60 min with no successful WhatsApp
-- confirmation row and no pending/active wa_jobs retry already queued.
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT so.shopify_id, so.order_number, so.customer_name, so.customer_phone,
         so.total_price, so.shopify_created_at
  FROM shopify_orders so
  WHERE so.shopify_created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 minutes'
    AND so.customer_phone IS NOT NULL
    AND so.customer_phone <> ''
)
SELECT r.order_number, r.customer_name, r.customer_phone, r.total_price
FROM recent r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM wa_messages m
  WHERE m.sent_by = 'journey:order_confirmation:' || r.order_number
    AND m.status IN ('sent','delivered','read')
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM wa_jobs j
  WHERE j.kind = 'order_confirmation'
    AND j.status = 'pending'
    AND j.payload->>'order_ref' = r.order_number
);

INSERT INTO wa_jobs (kind, payload, run_after, max_attempts)
VALUES ('order_confirmation', $1::jsonb, NOW(), 8);
